title: feat(ui): one lighter dialog surface, a single column for short create dialogs, and 「Create more」 (#35980)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuTcXgqb5mPHztr6LEnMPrLm)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWL2r2CuFr34ENybDB

Fixes #35980

> **This reverses a development default; the maintainer chose the threshold: six.** A create or edit dialog with at most six fields and no declared `columns` now draws one field per row at the `lg` size (672px) (ruling of record 7061696632 on #35980, choosing six over the card's proposed eight and over keeping two columns). That reverses the "at least two columns" development default from objectui#12521 and #34607. It does not overturn ruling 6204264665 on objectui#12521 (an undeclared count is the renderer's choice, a declared one is drawn as written): both halves still hold. The number is one constant (`DIALOG_SINGLE_COLUMN_MAX_FIELDS` in `autoLayout.ts`). The width change is commit `3612541e` (written at eight), reworded in `a141be6e` and set to six in `e86a699e`. Seven fields or more, any declared `columns`, an authored `modalSize` and a maximized dialog lay out as before.

Clause-②: yes (widening): `ModalFormSchema` (exported from the `@object-ui/plugin-form` entry) gains the optional `createMore?: boolean`, and `onSuccess` gains an optional second argument `{ createMore?: boolean }`, measured on the built `dist/ModalForm.d.ts`; `@object-ui/i18n`'s packs gain the key `form.createMore`. Nothing is removed or narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 所有弹出框（新建/编辑表单、删除确认、必填补填框）现在是同一个样子：背后页面只轻轻压暗（亮色 10%），不再模糊，背后内容仍看得清；弹框是白卡（暗色是略亮的深灰），细边加一圈 3px 半透明外圈，圆角 12px，阴影更柔；输入框、下拉、按钮从 40px 降到 32px。手机上仍是全屏，按钮保持 44px 好点。
- 新建/编辑表单标题 16px，前面带对象图标；内边距 20px。
- 字段不多（≤6 个）且没声明列数的表单，改成一列、宽 672px（以前是两列 1024px）。≥7 个字段、声明了列数或弹框尺寸、或者点了最大化的，和以前一样。这一条改掉的是 #12521/#34607 开发时定的「弹框至少两列」默认值，不推翻裁定 6204264665（没写列数由渲染器定、写了的照写，两条都守住）。阈值按你 11:07 的选择定为 6 个（裁定记录 7061696632）；数字是一个常量。
- 列表上点「新建」（以及相关列表里的子记录新建）的弹框左下有「连续创建」开关：打开后保存不关弹框，表单清空、光标回到第一格，背后列表刷新；关着就和以前一样保存后打开新记录。开关按对象记在这台浏览器里，这就是卡上「按人记住」的做法（同一个人换浏览器要再开一次）。
- ⌘↵（Windows 上 Ctrl+Enter）保存，按钮上显示按键提示。「取消」按钮保留。
- 弹框样子现在由弹框组件自己带着，控制台全局的 `[role="dialog"]` 圆角规则和遮罩模糊规则删掉了。侧边抽屉、弹出菜单不变。

## What changes

**One dialog surface** (`@object-ui/components`)

- New `src/lib/dialog-surface.ts` holds the look: `DIALOG_OVERLAY_SURFACE` (`bg-black/10`, `dark:bg-black/40`, no blur), `DIALOG_CONTENT_SURFACE` (theme card colour, hairline `border-black/[0.07]` / `dark:border-white/[0.09]`, `sm:rounded-[12px]`, a 3px translucent outer band drawn as the first shadow so a dialog that clips its overflow cannot cut it, then three soft shadows), and `DIALOG_COMPACT_CONTROLS` (from `sm` up, anything drawn at the shared 40px control height draws at 32px; the phone sheet keeps its `max-sm:` 44px targets).
- `ui/dialog.tsx` and `ui/alert-dialog.tsx` are Shadcn-synced, so they reach the look through declared patches in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`: one import and one class token each on the overlay and the content (`dialogSurfacePatches`, six patches). The surface classes come before the call site's `className`, so a caller still wins. `alert-dialog` had no declared patches; its upstream registry file is vendored as a fixture (`alert-dialog.registry.txt`, pinned sha256, round-trip checked) like `dialog`'s. `shadcn-components.json` lists both local edits.
- `custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx` (the form dialog's content) appends the same surface.

**Console global CSS** (`apps/console/src/index.css`)

- The `[role="dialog"]:not(.inset-y-0) { border-radius: 1.25rem !important }` rule is gone. Popovers (Radix popover content is `role="dialog"`) and the vaul bottom drawer keep their 20px corner through their own containers: `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] > [role="dialog"], [data-vaul-drawer]`.
- The shared floating-surface shadow skips `.dialog-surface`, because the card draws its own.
- The `bg-black/80` overlay blur rule stays but now reaches only drawer overlays: dialog overlays no longer carry `bg-black/80`.

**The form dialog** (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, `ModalForm.tsx`)

- Header: title 16px (`text-base`) with the object's icon (`resolveIcon(objectSchema.icon)`, `aria-hidden`); header, body and footer padding 20px from `sm` up; the footer bar is the card colour, not the page grey.
- 「Create more」: `schema.createMore === true` on a `create` dialog shows a switch in the footer. On, a save calls `onSuccess(result, { createMore: true })`, clears the form (a keyed remount), clears the dirty flag and puts focus on the first editable field; the dialog stays open. Off, nothing changes. The switch is stored per object in `localStorage` (`modal-form-create-more:<object>`, every access guarded), so it is remembered per object in this browser.
- ⌘↵ / Ctrl+Enter inside the dialog submits the form (`requestSubmit`, so validation runs), unless a submit or an upload is in flight or the IME is composing. The submit button carries `aria-keyshortcuts` and shows the keycaps from `sm` up.
- Width (`3612541e`, set to six in `e86a699e`): `dialogDrawsSingleColumn(fieldCount, formColumns, sectionColumns)` in `autoLayout.ts` is true when the laid-out field count is at most six (`DIALOG_SINGLE_COLUMN_MAX_FIELDS`, ruling 7061696632) and neither the form nor any section declares `columns`. Then the dialog takes `inferModalSize(1)` (`lg`) and the undeclared columns are 1. Not on a maximized dialog, not when `modalSize` is authored. Neither helper is on the package entry.

**Console host** (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `AppContent.tsx`)

- The list's 「New」 dialog and a related list's child create pass `createMore: true`. `handleRecordFormSuccess(saved, outcome)` with `outcome.createMore` shows the saved toast and bumps the list's refresh key (not for a child task, which refreshes its own related list), and returns without closing or opening the new record. Without it, the record opens as before.

**The `object-form` renderer** (`ObjectFormContainer`, `formType: 'modal'`): passes `createMore: false`, so a page schema's stray `createMore` (the schema's index signature would carry it through the spread) never turns the switch on; 「Create more」 is a host's opt-in on `ModalForm` only.

**Strings**: `form.createMore` in all eleven packs (`zh-Hant.ts` regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`), plus the provider-less default in `ModalForm`.

## Why

Card #35980 (epic #34571): the dialogs read heavy against the page (a blurred 35% overlay, a grey card at 20px, 40px controls, two columns for a four-field form), and a person entering several records had to reopen the dialog each time. The card asks for one lighter surface owned by the dialog components, a narrow column for short forms, and a create dialog that can stay open.

## Side effects reviewers should know

- The compact-controls rule reaches every `h-10` element inside a dialog (inputs, select triggers, default and icon buttons, and any other 40px element such as an avatar), not only form controls; a non-square one also gains `py-1`. The changeset says so.
- 「⌘↵」 and 「Create more」 are on the flat form only; the master-detail dialog (lines) takes neither. The changeset says so.
- The `dialog-surface` class is a contract between `@object-ui/components` and the console's `index.css`; both sides carry a comment naming the other.

- Top and bottom sheets and any custom element with `role="dialog"` that relied on the old global 20px rule now draw their own corner (bottom drawer and popovers keep 20px through the rule above; the edge-sheet test pins left, right, top and bottom).
- The outer band is a shadow, with no backdrop blur of its own.
- Drawer overlays are unchanged.

## Tests

- Changed: `apps/console/src/__tests__/edgeSheetSquareCorners-35411.test.tsx`: the corner selector names the popper wrapper and the vaul drawer and no part starts with `[role="dialog"]`; no sheet side is matched; a centred dialog is not matched and carries `sm:rounded-[12px]`.
- Changed: `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`: the alert-dialog fixture entry; the pinned `applied` count in the dialog-Close drift test is 2 → 5 (three new dialog patches).
- Changed for the width reversal: `dialogDefaultLayout-12521.test.tsx` (the short form has no grid; the `span: 'full'` case uses a nine-field section and still expects the wide ladder), `dialogContainerColumns-34607.test.tsx` (the light form is `lg` with ladder [1,1,1]; new describe with 7 cases: the predicate (6 → one column; 7, 8, 9 → not); six flat fields → one column `lg`; seven → as before (`xl`, two columns); undeclared sections of six in all → one column; a declared form `columns` as written; one declared section keeps the dialog as it was; an authored `modalSize` wins), `fieldGroupSections.test.tsx` (host-aware: the modal draws no `@md:grid-cols-2`, the drawer still does), `modalFieldGroups.test.tsx`.
- Changed for the surface: `subformHosts.test.tsx` (`bg-card`, `sm:px-5`), `snapshot-critical.test.tsx.snap` (dialog classes), `FormSectionNav.test.tsx` (the header-border check waits for layout; timing only).
- New: `modalMaximize-34604.test.tsx` describe 「Create more」 with 10 cases (switch only when the host asks and only on a create; an `object-form` page schema that writes `createMore` through `ObjectFormContainer` gets no switch (fails with the container's `createMore: false` removed); off → closes and the host is not told to stay; on → stays open, form empty, focus first, saves again; reopens as last left, per object; ⌘↵ and Ctrl+Enter save, Shift or a lone Enter do not; the keycaps; the title icon; no icon → title alone). `AppContent.createLandingOriginPlural-11733.test.tsx`: create-more stays on the list and refreshes it (fails with the `outcome.createMore` branch removed).
- No test deleted or skipped.
- Local runs: `@object-ui/plugin-form` 2,723 passed before the new pins, then the changed and new files (`modalMaximize-34604` 20 passed, the width files, the host-parity files) passed; `@object-ui/components` 1 failure, the dialog snapshot, regenerated in `6e8a3744`; `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts` passed. `type-check` (src and tests) clean for plugin-form, components and app-shell; ESLint on every changed file: no errors. After `e86a699e`: `@object-ui/plugin-form` 2,732 passed / 1 skipped. `@object-ui/console` 3,470 passed; `@object-ui/fields` 4,717 passed / 7 skipped; the `@object-ui/app-shell` suite outran the local 25-minute limit, and CI's Test UI (16 shards, green on `2019d2ce`) is its reading.

## Browser evidence (CRM example, console, zh-CN)

Before and after screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35980/before/` and `after/` (seat-side folder; script `shots.cjs`, `flows.cjs`).

| Reading | Before (`be91bfc2`) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Create dialog, 4 fields, 1280 light | 1024×356, radius 20, bg `rgb(246,246,249)`, overlay 35% + `blur(8px) saturate(1.4)`, controls 40, title 18 | 672×422, radius 12, bg white, overlay 10%, no backdrop filter, controls 32, title 16, one column |
| Same, 1280 dark | grey card, blurred overlay | bg `rgb(24,24,27)`, overlay 40%, no backdrop filter |
| Same, 375 light / dark | full-screen sheet | full-screen sheet, radius 0, controls 44 |
| 13-field object (`crm_lead`), 1280 | two columns, 1024 | two columns, 1024 (unchanged) |
| Delete confirmation, light / dark | not measured (upstream `sm:rounded-lg`; the old global rule matched `role="dialog"`, not `alertdialog`) | radius 12, white / `rgb(24,24,27)`, buttons 32 |
| Filter popover | radius 20 (old global rule) | radius 20 (popper rule) |
| 6 fields, 1366×768 (two demo fields added to `crm_contact` locally, not committed) | — | 672×566, one column, nothing scrolls, 「创建」 visible |
| 8 fields, 1366×768, measured at the earlier threshold of eight to inform the choice (four demo fields added to `crm_account` locally, not committed; at six, eight fields draw two columns as before) | — | 672×691 (the dialog's height cap), the body scrolls 27px: the 8th field's control is cut at the bottom; 「创建」 stays visible in the fixed footer |
| Same at 1366×657 (a 768px screen less the browser's own bars) | — | 6 fields: 566, nothing scrolls; 8 fields: 591 cap, the body scrolls 127px (about the last two fields); 「创建」 stays visible |
| 「连续创建」 on, Ctrl+Enter | — | dialog stays open, first field empty and focused, list 3 → 4 rows with the new record, toast shown; switch still on after close and reopen |
